reviews.text: We turned to Francesco for help with our Yorkshire Terrier, who would attack every dog ​​she encountered, even from a distance. After just two group lessons, the situation changed radically, as did our relationship with Polly. Francesco is frank and direct, he tells you how things are, and he gives you the keys to making them work. As is often the case, the first thing we learn is about our owners, not our dogs. We still have several lessons to go, and we, like Polly, can't wait to start taking lessons to build our relationship and perhaps discover new things. Because Lifebound is all this and so much more! We honestly can't thank them enough!

I spent the first year after adopting my dog ​​Leo, going through various trainers, always with little success compared to the results I'd hoped for or promised. After taking him in from the shelter, management issues arose that every first-time owner faces: sometimes they were downplayed just to reassure him, other times they were based on remote causes that were difficult to resolve, or that didn't take the slightest account of the dog's specific daily environment. About a year after adoption and with the wrong approaches, Leo received a report for a bite, which is why I turned to the professionals at Lifebound K9, hoping to try to get out of the situation I found myself in.
I found a wonderful dog training center, with competent staff who supported me both inside and outside of every problem I encountered with Leo. They were always available, patient, attentive, but also, and above all, assertive when the situation required it. If I had gone to them right away, I most likely wouldn't have even found myself in the situation of asking for this kind of support, which was given to me as if it were the most normal thing in the world for them. I'm grateful every day that there are professionals and human beings like those I've met within this facility. A training ground for life, even more than a dog training program.

We decided to enroll our 5-month-old poodle at this center for an educational program. After an initial free introductory meeting, we purchased a package of lessons with advance payment.
Our experience, however, was disappointing. When we signed the membership form, we weren't explicitly informed that it included the rules regarding lesson management and cancellations.
Furthermore, we weren't given a receipt when we paid.
During the third meeting, due to severe weather, we informed the center shortly before the appointment that we couldn't bring our puppy to the camp, as the facility is completely outdoors. We were told that lessons can only be canceled at the center's discretion, and that, since we hadn't respected the 24-hour notice required by the rules, the lesson would be considered forfeited.
While we acknowledge that this rule was included in the membership, we would have appreciated greater flexibility and understanding for what, in our case, was an occasional unforeseen event related to weather conditions and the well-being of a very young puppy.
The main problem, as far as we're concerned, wasn't the 24-hour rule itself, but the way it was communicated to us. We perceived the responses we received as arrogant and disrespectful to the client.
Subsequently, we saw content posted on social media that, although not directly quoting us, seemed to relate to our situation, which left us
even more uncomfortable.
From an educational standpoint, during the first lessons, we didn't feel like the program was particularly personalized to our dog's needs. For example, the topic of muzzles was addressed as early as the second lesson, a topic that, in our opinion, seemed irrelevant for a 5-month-old poodle.
We didn't feel welcomed or
supported in the way we expected.

I'm sorry to have to give one star, but unfortunately, that's the best I can give.
Not for the training itself, since I only had two lessons, but for the human side, which is completely lacking in between.
One day, I had to cancel a lesson at the last minute because it started pouring with rain right when we were supposed to start.
I felt completely cheated, as if it were a given to take a lesson in the rain with a 5-month-old poodle.
According to him, I wasn't within the cancellation deadline, saying he'd still take the money. I UNDERSTAND: they never specified, either in text or verbally, when all the lessons had been paid IN ADVANCE.
They claim they're right because the clause was written in the membership form.
Literally, that membership form is made to be filled out BEFORE you even pay and is only used to register you (they pass it off as such). But then the catch: down at the bottom, in a TINY link that you have to click, there's a Pandora's box: A LIST OF RULES and CLAUSES that are never specified.
Basically, you think you're just registering, and they're setting you up without even knowing it.
It's nice to get the money up front with no transparency, right? Convenient, right?
Not to mention the fact that the day after the "discussion" about canceling, the trainer posted a video referring to those who cancel at the last minute, using jargon I can't even write because otherwise they'll ban me.
It made me feel humiliated, mocked, and completely taken for a ride. How do you think anyone could come back after something like that?
You can keep my advance payment for 10 lessons, but I assure you, you can't buy TRANSPARENCY from anyone with that kind of money.
Best regards.
I only know him through social media but I don't miss any of his advice and he's also very kind as he always responded to my requests for help for my dog. Thank you very much.

I spent about two months in Rome for work. I knew about the center from social media, and I always found his vision of dog training to be in line with my own, so I decided to take a few lessons with him. From the very first lesson, Francesco demonstrated his knowledge of the subject and what he was doing, as did his assistants. Strict rules within the camp, ensuring safe fun and developing both the team and the individual, ensured that my time there was of the highest quality.
There is not much to add simply the top

We've been following Francesco since before we got our little earthquake Rocky, so we couldn't help but choose him...
He's very competent; everything he says and does is done with purpose and because you can see he loves his job and continues to study to improve even more!
He was the perfect fit for us, especially for me, as it was my first experience with a dog, especially a Staffy 😅.
Despite the distance and various commitments, it's easy for us to go to him and improve our relationship with Rocky.
He's created a wonderful group with dogs of all types and personalities.
NUMBER ONE

We can only express our utmost satisfaction with the experience we've had with Life Bound K9 in Rome.
I contacted Francesco even before getting the puppy, asking for advice on which breeders I could trust. He was very helpful, answering all my questions. I don't think that's a given; he wasn't required to do so, and we didn't even know each other. Obviously, despite his advice, I went my own way, making the first mistake. We started the process as soon as possible. Our puppy, Marzio, a large Poodle, immediately showed many insecurities and uncertainties, likely due to the lack of socialization he'd had before arriving with us. He was very fearful, suspicious of strangers, easily startled by loud noises, and couldn't stay home alone without becoming anxious.
From our first meeting, we were greeted with great professionalism and availability. Francesco taught us how to work properly with Marzio, guiding us step by step with infinite patience and making us understand the importance of observing and interpreting a dog's language, knowing when to push, but above all, when to stop and take a step back. It helped us recognize and value those small improvements that go unnoticed by us, but which represent major achievements for those who truly understand dog behavior.
Thanks to the training we completed, Marzio is now a much calmer and more open dog: he lets strangers approach and pet him, he faces situations that previously made him difficult with greater ease, he's no longer afraid of loud noises like he once did, and he's learned to manage even the moments when he has to be left alone at home much better.
We're extremely satisfied with the results achieved so far and enthusiastically continue to attend the adult class every week. For us, it has become a valuable opportunity to improve our dog management skills and build an increasingly balanced relationship, allowing the whole family, Marzio included, to experience a peaceful, fulfilling, and satisfying coexistence.
We recommend Life Bound K9 and Francesco to anyone who wants to rely on competent, trained, welcoming professionals who truly care about the well-being not of the dog itself but of the duo as a whole, for all those who believe in that bond that lasts a lifetime. 🐕🚶‍♀️⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Simona and Barbara
I had a great time, I recommend it to everyone!

I had the opportunity to do an internship with Francesco. He was incredibly knowledgeable and had the ability to explain things clearly and unequivocally. Thanks to him, I understood the problem I was having: even trainers need to be trained... by the best! Thanks, Fra!

We turned to Francesco and his team because, despite having already undertaken a program at another dog training center, our dog continued to have serious difficulties managing his emotions. He was always very excited, constantly tugged on the leash, and often refused to cooperate in the field.

I must admit that at first it wasn't easy to understand Francesco and his team's working method. They seemed lacking in empathy, and we felt like we didn't fully understand the direction of the program. As the weeks passed, however, we understood one fundamental thing: the problem wasn't the dog.

Francesco worked primarily on us, helping us understand our mistakes, our way of communicating, and our relationships with him. He taught us to be more balanced and aware guides.

After just a month, the results were surprising: today we have a calm, contented, and much more balanced dog. He walks on heel without pulling, calmly ignores other dogs who bark at him, and, above all, lives every moment of the day by our side with calm and trust.

For us, it was a real life-changing experience. We can only thank Francesco and his entire staff for their professionalism, expertise, and dedication. We recommend this program to anyone who truly wants to understand their dog and build a healthy, lasting relationship with them.
Great dog culture (and not only) which is quite difficult to find these days. If he also trained cats, I would take them to him in a hurry!!
He's certainly one of the few who speaks clearly and takes action for the dog's well-being. In a world of dog gurus, he's a true reflection of dog-loving.

I turned to this dog training center primarily to try the pool experience with my dogs. I already knew the trainer through social media and had met him in person at an event. The content he shares online closely reflects my vision of dog training, which is why I decided to entrust myself to him without any hesitation.

Unfortunately, the hands-on experience didn't live up to expectations.

After over an hour's drive, we arrived with two very excited dogs who needed to relieve themselves. Despite this, we were escorted to an area where we were told they were not allowed to urinate or defecate, a situation that was particularly difficult for me, especially considering I was traveling with a four-month-old Malinois puppy.

The pool lesson was conducted with what I perceived as very limited participation from the trainer. I had made it clear that it was my first experience in the water with dogs and that I would need guidance on how to help them positively approach the aquatic environment. Instead, for much of the time I felt like the facility had simply been provided to me, without any real support or teaching. The little information I received came almost exclusively in response to my questions.

During the session with my second dog, the trainer also expressed a negative opinion about the dog he was born from, calling him problematic and stating that he shouldn't have been bred. I found the comment unprofessional, both because it was directed at someone I know and respect, and because it was formulated without any relevance to the work we were doing.

At the end of the session, I received some criticism regarding the way I handled my puppy. I have no problem accepting comments or advice; in fact, I consider them essential to my growth as an owner. However, in this case, a thorough assessment of the dog or the process we are following had never been conducted. Some considerations were made based on very limited information, and when I tried to explain the context behind certain decisions, I was not given the opportunity to complete the discussion. I felt like they'd jumped to conclusions without really knowing the situation.

What disappointed me most was the lack of a real training program. I'm used to working with professionals who explain, observe, correct, and, above all, provide concrete tools to apply once we return home. In this case, I left the experience without receiving practical guidance on how to help my dogs in the water and without the sense of having built a foundation for future encounters.

In conclusion, I personally didn't have a good experience. I invested time, money, and over an hour's travel time to get to the center, but I didn't receive the support I expected. For those looking for consistent guidance and a structured program, this wasn't, in my experience, the right choice.

A highly respected dog training center. Trainer Francesco and his staff are competent and professional, both professionally and personally. I thank Francesco for giving us the opportunity to get to know our four-legged friends so well.

I met Francesco through social media, and after following him for a while, I decided to embark on a journey with my two dogs.
Francesco and his entire team (Corinna and Angelica) are truly highly trained, they really know what they're doing, and most importantly, they love what they do—you can tell right away.
In a short time, my relationship with my two dogs has improved significantly, and the results are visible even off the field; we've done a lot of work.
This isn't necessarily a given, but they're truly wonderful people, even outside of work. They've always been available for clarification, advice, and why not, even for a nice barbecue party on the field.
Thanks for everything, see you soon!

I did a full immersion course on May 29th and 30th at un.ss., and I have to say it was the perfect choice. Francesco is just as you see him in the video: frank, sincere, and friendly. Despite his extensive training, he doesn't put himself on a pedestal and does everything he can to connect with the team. He opens your mind and perhaps even raises your doubts, but I believe that questioning yourself is just a spur to keep going and try to learn something new every day. Well done, keep an eye on the oak tree! 🤣
Thank you, Francesco. I've done it in person, over the phone, and now in this review too.
Ad maiora...

I've been following Francesco on social media for a long time and have always been fascinated by his approach and his content. I came to the dog training center about three or four months ago with my puppy to try to resolve some issues I would never have dared to address on my own, and I must say that, step by step, we're succeeding. There have been many improvements, and I'm so happy about it! The road is still long, but the journey will be wonderful. Thanks to Francesco and the entire LifeboundK9 team.

Highly recommended! I left Latina without any expectations, it wasn't my first time with a trainer. I'm coming! Off to the training camp and we're starting with theory... Enlightening!!! I think it's Francesco's characteristic of being extremely direct. We had individual and group practice lessons on Friday and Saturday and... my Ugo immediately changed! Not because of a miracle involving the dog, but rather because of the awareness I've gained of my mistakes towards Ugo, my Lagotto! Thank you Francesco, we'll see each other soon to continue to change!

My fiancé and I arrived from Campania for a two-day full immersion training session after changing three trainers, with a six-month-old dog who was extremely sensitive, fearful, with an unknown past, and with many questions and few certainties. One could list the numerous skills of Francesco and his team, which are evident from the very first moment, but what really makes the difference for me is something else: leaving a training session feeling more relaxed, more aware, and finally with clear ideas. After these two days with Francesco, that's exactly what happened to us. His approach is direct, concrete, and without mincing words: he gets straight to the point, but always with the goal of truly understanding what's happening between us and our dog. And this, in the vast and complex world of dog training, is by no means a given. We were offered perspectives we had never considered, and situations that previously seemed like problems finally became understandable and manageable. This shift in perspective is something we felt not only in ourselves, but also in the others attending the classes: a shared sense of clarity, joy, confidence, and direction. An intense but extremely useful experience, it gave us concrete tools and, above all, the feeling of finally being on the right path. Thank you, we'll be back soon! :)
A wonderful experience! A wonderful place! Ciro and I will treasure the teachings of Francesco, Angelica, and Connie. We'll be back soon. 💕💪🏻 …

After extensively browsing Francesco and Lifeboundk9's social media, I finally managed to visit the training center for a full immersion with my Belgian Malinois.
I thoroughly enjoyed the initial theoretical introduction to dog management, as well as the practical training that took place in the field. The explanations were clear and concise, and the duo showed complete respect.
When I have the chance, we'll visit again, and I highly recommend it.
Expertise, professionalism, and focused work on the dog. Excellent dog training center. The results, if you really work hard and follow the instructions, are there! Truly excellent!

I discovered Francesco and his Center through social media and was immediately impressed by the expertise and passion that shines through in his videos.
Unfortunately, distance prevents me from following a consistent program, but the Full Immersion program offered has been enlightening in many ways.
I've been attending a local dog training center for some time, but the quality and approach I've found with Francesco and the LBK9 team have been truly exceptional.
We'll definitely be back in the future to evaluate the progress we've made following their valuable advice. A truly first-class experience!
A truly extraordinary experience. The instructor is tough with humans and gentle with dogs, just what we were looking for. He's teaching us how to become good owners. Highly recommended.

Thank you. Francesco knows how to help you build a relationship with your dog. The ferocious beast after Francesco listens to you and looks at you with interest. It's a tough journey. Very demanding. But all the good things in life are.

We, the owners of a Rhodesian Ridgeback, turned to Lifebound K9 to improve our dog management. From the first purely theoretical lesson, we appreciated Francesco's knowledge in the canine field but also in various cultural contexts. On a practical level, we immediately understood the effects of a highly effective method on both the dog and the owners. 😊 Highly recommended 👍

If you're looking for accessible expertise and professionalism, comprehensive, detailed explanations that even beginners can understand, an environment that puts you and your dog at ease, and—why not?—lots of laughter, this is the place for you. This is my third dog; I've been to other dog training centers, but this is the one I liked the most! 5 well-deserved stars!
Best wishes for a happy new year... I can't wait to get started after the holidays! 💪 …
I've never had the chance to meet the owner in person, but I follow him assiduously on social media and he always gives excellent advice. He's a very direct and knowledgeable person.

Francesco (and his staff) is the light that shines on the dark sides of my Kali's character. Or perhaps it's more appropriate to say that he's the beacon that illuminates my growing relationship with my dog.
Be that as it may, Lifebound K9 is the best place for Kali and I to find ourselves...
Thank you!

I entrusted them with my Sheena months ago, having some issues with managing her at home with other people and on walks. In just a few lessons, they helped me understand HOW a dog really thinks, which is the foundation of everything. From the very first conversation without the dog, I began to visibly improve Sheena's behavior, because yes, the problem in 90% of cases is the way we communicate. They then introduced me to the tools needed for proper management. I had to stop only for financial reasons, but I would definitely return! Highly recommended, and know that to improve your dog's health, you have to be willing to put yourself out there.
The best ever.

Francesco is a true professional, an excellent communicator, and a keen reader of dogs. His staff is extremely knowledgeable, and the camp is clean and perfectly organized. Highly recommended for both first-time dog walkers seeking the best, and experienced walkers seeking quality, precise work that respects the dog's individuality.

I've been to various training centers since my Argo, an American Staffordshire Terrier, was 5 months old. None of them have ever convinced me. Too much talk, too little work, methods that yielded no results. Endless olfactory experiments with sausages "so the dog relaxes and doesn't notice other dogs"... then we arrive at the Lifebound K9 center and I have my first meeting with Francesco. Clear, concise, with a stern, decisive, technical demeanor!! But he gives the impression he knows exactly what he's talking about. I'm starting his group training sessions.

Argo is now 2 years old and is becoming a gem, and I'm working with him, because Francesco teaches us to be a team! Working together to create a unique bond!!!

A few days ago, we earned our CAE-1 certification, and it was a wonderful experience. For us, Francesco is no longer the strict, technical person... Francesco is a motivator, an empathetic person. He understands human behavior as well as that of dogs. He knows how to stimulate you, how to correct you, how to calm you down, and every scolding is always motivating and valuable for learning and improving.
For us, working with Francesco wasn't just an experience, it was a fantastic journey!!

I write this review from the heart.
What can I say? Francesco is definitely a frank person who leaves no room for interpretation. He might seem rude to some because he slaps the truth in their faces that owners don't want to hear. My Ginger is my joy. I worked on her, but without people like Francesco, I wouldn't have gotten far. The words that come out of his mouth are wise. If everything is followed to the letter and, above all, respected off the field, the improvements are evident. It takes patience and perseverance, but anything can be done!
He puts in his effort, but you who set foot on the field must do the same! Thank you, Francesco, for giving me even more determination than I already have!

We were browsing Francesco and LFK9's social media before we even had a dog!
Then we welcomed Rocky into the family and decided to embark on an educational program that we thought was for him, but which, lesson after lesson, we're realizing IS FOR US!!!
The Quadraro center isn't exactly on the way, but from the evaluation we made at the open day, it was clear to us that we couldn't have found a better one.
The program we're following is worth every single minute and kilometer spent in the increasingly insane Roman traffic.
Francesco does this job because he loves it, and this passion shines through in every word, every explanation, and every correction.
Personally, we also like his pragmatism, so we hit it off right away!

Regarding my experience with the Lifebound dog training camp, I don't want to criticize the method, much less the expertise, because I have no authority to do so. What I do want to strongly criticize is the humane approach, not to the dog, but to people. As soon as you park, the camp owner yells at you to keep the dog in the car. That's fair, but there are different ways to say things. At the same time, the approach is always based on "you're doing it all wrong," not "don't worry, things will get better little by little." We were given the puppy class on Thursday at 7 p.m. My wife suffers from retinitis pigmentosa and can't drive at night. I'm not available on Thursdays, and there was never a chance to reschedule. In the end, we gave up and left the camp €70 for work they didn't do. Please note: we knew they were non-refundable and we're not complaining about that, but what really bothered us was the lack of availability. We came from 45 km away to improve our dog's training, and with their lack of flexibility, it wasn't possible. I have nothing to say about the method, but there's a lot to discuss about the human touch.

I discovered this dog training center through social media, drawn to Francesco's simple and direct explanations and the work he demonstrated. I asked for his help with my two dogs, now adults (but it's never too late!). He's the same frank and direct person, but never pedantic. Francesco is truly passionate about what he does, but also incredibly knowledgeable; he understands dogs and owners at a glance and guides you step by step through ups, downs, and goals. His staff are equally skilled. Our training began a few months ago, and the improvements are remarkable. Thanks to all the staff for their dedication, commitment, and determination: having solid guidance is essential on this journey.

Joining Lifebound K9 was the best choice I could have made for me and my dog, Tequila (American Pitbull Terrier). Francesco is not only an excellent professional, he's a guide who brings rare passion to every single pair he works with.
At this center, I've seen miracles: dogs overcome deep fears and owners return home happy and proud of their achievements. For us, the journey with Francesco took us far beyond simple training: he taught us to build a special bond, a true 'Perfect Pair' based on trust and mutual respect. This harmony not only allows us to experience every social context peacefully, but it also spurs us on every day to achieve new goals, even in sport.
A special thank you goes to you, Francesco: thank you for your dedication, your professionalism, and the way you inspire us with every small achievement. Lifebound K9 is now part of our daily lives, and I can tell you right now, it will be hard to let you go! We love working hard alongside you because the real magic It is on this journey that we are taking together, one conquest at a time!

When social media transmits culture.
I came to the dog training center thanks to the videos I kept seeing on TikTok, where I first heard about 360-degree dog training.
I decided to try a program with my dog, and the impression I'd gotten from one video was confirmed once I crossed the threshold of the center's gates.
Francesco is extremely knowledgeable and attentive; for every action/reaction, he always provides an explanation and repeats it until you understand it (thanks for his patience).
He helped me build a good relationship with my dog ​​(very fearful and stubborn), to understand how to read his behaviors and how to correct mine.
We started with the simple things, which are actually part of everyday life: how to go for a walk, how to stay calm around other dogs, how to cope with loud noises without panicking, how to be a guide for my dog.
Today I'm a more aware owner and can always try to add new pieces.
We still have a lot to build, but I know I can count on Francesco and his staff and their professionalism and passion.

We came to Francesco because our Doberman, following an accident, was terrified of crossing the street and it had become a huge problem to take her out. Not only did he explain seemingly simple but actually fundamental things to us in a couple of lessons, which completely changed our approach to going out, quickly improving the situation. Thanks to him, we also discovered how fun and, above all, rewarding it is to undertake a training program and how much it can strengthen the bond with our Ashe. That's why, even after the road issue is resolved, we can't wait to continue with the lessons. There's a world to discover here!

Fantastic and knowledgeable people. Top dog training center that helps you through everything.
Today I passed the CAE1 test with 100/100.
Thanks again.

Before meeting Francesco from Lifebound K9 Derek, my Amstaff was terrible; he couldn't even sit still for two seconds.
I recommend all owners of dogs with problems to contact him; he's truly knowledgeable.
This is Derek today.

After trying three different centers without great results, I finally found the right program for my dog ​​Pepe and for me. The progress was evident from the first lessons.

The instructors are knowledgeable, clear, and very helpful: they gave me simple but truly effective advice, useful not only for my dog ​​but also for me in my daily management.

We concluded the program with a group lesson, and it was truly instructive for both of us. As soon as I have the chance, we will definitely return for more group lessons.

I am truly satisfied with the experience and the improvements I have made.
Highly recommended! 🐾

After seeing and listening to countless trainers and educators, and after spending time and money on every type of technique and approach, I put my trust in Francesco. I must say that I immediately noticed his expertise.

It's not easy—I say this especially to those, like me, who live with dogs they love deeply but haven't been able to manage for years. My two dogs are my family and I am theirs, but before starting this journey, my life had become truly complicated: even the thought of taking them out for a walk made me feel sick.

They are two mixed-breed dogs found in a landfill, with whom I've been through absolutely everything. I ended up in the hospital for a bite, and I ended up having to file a complaint because my male dog bit a six-month-old puppy and his owner, who needed seven stitches in her arm. Together, my two dogs made me think several times that there was no way out: in addition to attacking other dogs, they had become completely unmanageable for me. The male dog even ended up under a car, risking his life.

At a certain point, I decided to turn to Lifebound K9 to sort things out and finally feel more at peace.

It's not all sunshine and rainbows—in fact, I'll tell you straight: if you think this is just another center, you're wrong.
The approach is strong. I'm not talking about violence, absolutely not, but about intensity. Especially for us owners. I won't deny that I cried during the first lesson. I had already trained in the past, but with Francesco, I understood that this is a different kind of journey.

It's a change that requires commitment, patience, and consistency. There were times when I wanted to give up, but now I can't wait to continue improving.

Today, with a fever of 100.4°F, I went out with my male dog: I was barely able to walk, but for weeks now, he's seemed like a different dog. He listens to me. I've truly learned to communicate with him, and he's giving me satisfaction I never imagined.
Now I'll start with the super fearful and often aggressive female, and I know that if you guide us properly, we'll make great progress.

If you want to change your life with your dog for the better, now you know who to turn to.

Francesco welcomed us kindly and confidently. We arrived with Max, our volcano-like mixed breed, in the wonderful place he/they built for dogs of all breeds.
We had a lovely chat under the trees and returned home with more knowledge to live happily together.
Thank you, Lifebound K9

I went to this dog training center to understand my dog ​​and his needs, and to determine where our work should focus as a team. In addition to their helpfulness and kindness, we also found the professionalism that allowed for direct communication, easily understood by "ordinary" people like me. They provided nonjudgmental explanations (which is unfortunately not so common). They also were willing to direct me to professionals closer to our area (since we come from quite far away). I also want to emphasize that, having participated in the "pup-training program," I didn't find one of those sadly common "socialization classes" with puppies thrown into a fenced area and making a racket, but a structured lesson, with a purpose, even addressing the "difficulties" of everyday walks, with the added incentive of noise to start preparing for New Year's Eve.
And I thank Francesco so much for all the reasons mentioned above, for how he worked with us and for putting up with all my being a little too verbose in speaking, and if you hear Madonnas flying it will be because I'm back to do a full immersion with the teenage dog ❤️

I discovered Lifebound K9 on Instagram, but once I met Francesco and all the other instructors, I felt lucky: professionalism, friendliness, passion, and love for their work and for our four-legged friends. I couldn't have asked for anything better. I feel understood, supported, and always helped, given their availability and daily support. My Charlie and I are doing an incredible job, and I feel happier every day with him because we're starting to understand each other more and more.

I had an extraordinary experience with Francesco and his team: from the very beginning, I noticed incredible improvements. We had tried other trainers in the past, but none had provided us with a truly structured and clear method. They, however, helped me fully understand my extremely fearful dog and manage her with greater confidence. I learned that seemingly simple gestures, like playing or cuddling, are far from obvious and can make a huge difference. It was an invaluable help, and I highly recommend them!

I recommend Francesco and his team to anyone who cares about their dog, by choice and because he's the only trainer in the area to be called such! He's the only one who tells you things as they really are, using the right words and the right approach, and if you get offended, you pay the price! As his slogan says, they train dogs and educate people, because people need to be truly educated, even about their dogs and how to handle them, to truly love them. It's certainly a challenging journey if you're coming from far away, but it's 100% worth it. Every breed, and not just any dog, is trained in a certain way, so we shouldn't tar everyone with the same brush. Every breed has its own temperament, and every dog ​​has its own talents and qualities. He's very attentive to this, as well as everything else that reflects the dog-owner world, with a solid, proven foundation, not just fluff. What can I say, you have to! LifeBound, bound for life!
